summary: The test suite has solid unit-test coverage of the matrix generator's core logic (cycles 1-5 in matrix_gen.bats) and validates workflow structure (workflow.bats), but critically fails to meet the stated requirement that "ALL TESTS MUST RUN THROUGH ACT." The unit tests cover matrix generation, validation, size limits, and include/exclude rules well, but workflow.bats only verifies YAML structure and actionlint compliance—it does not exercise the actual workflow execution. The run_act_tests.sh script exists as a separate harness implementing the required act-based testing pattern, but contains only 2 test cases while the unit suite covers many more scenarios; this disconnect means most functionality gaps would not be caught by the end-to-end pipeline. Missing: shellcheck and bash -n validation tests (explicitly required), comprehensive act scenario coverage, and fixture-file visibility (referenced but not shown). Test design is clean with clear naming and cycle organization, but the separation of unit and integration testing undermines the goal of catching regressions in a CI/CD context.
